title: Sparse Oblique Rule Boosting for Simpler Additive Rule Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2609.06426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small additive ensembles of symbolic rules offer interpretable prediction models. Traditionally, these ensembles use rule conditions based on conjunctions of simple threshold propositions $x \geq t$ on a single input variable $x$ and threshold $t$, resulting geometrically in axis-parallel polytopes as decision regions. While this form ensures a high degree of interpretability for individual rules and can be learned efficiently using the gradient boosting approach, it relies on having access to a curated set of expressive input features so that a small ensemble of axis-parallel regions can describe the target variable well. Absent such features, reaching sufficient accuracy requires increasing the number and complexity of individual rules, which diminishes the interpretability of the model. translated_title: 面向更简单加性规则集成的稀疏斜交规则提升方法
translated_abstract: 小型加性符号规则集成能够提供可解释的预测模型。传统上，这些集成使用的规则条件基于单个输入变量x和阈值t的简单阈值命题（x ≥ t）的合取，在几何上形成轴平行的多面体作为决策区域。虽然这种形式确保了单个规则的高度可解释性，并且可以通过梯度提升方法高效学习，但它依赖于获得一组精心设计的、具有丰富表达力的输入特征，从而使小型轴平行区域集成能够很好地描述目标变量。在缺乏此类特征的情况下，达到足够的预测精度需要增加单个规则的数量和复杂性，这会降低模型的可解释性。本文通过引入包含输入变量可学习稀疏线性变换的逻辑命题，对经典规则集成方法进行了扩展，从而……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种稀疏斜交规则提升方法，通过在逻辑命题中引入可学习的稀疏线性变换来扩展经典规则集成，使模型能够以更简单的规则获得足够的预测精度，同时保持良好的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sparse oblique rule boosting, which extends classical rule ensembles by introducing logical propositions with learnable sparse linear transformations of input variables, enabling simpler rule ensembles to achieve sufficient accuracy while maintaining interpretability.
